item.title: December Order on Inactive FCC Proceedings Effective Friday
item.description: A December order by the FCC Consumer and Governmental Affairs Bureau, which terminated 2,048 inactive proceedings while leaving open nine that had been considered for closure (see [Ref:2512030028]), takes effect Friday, said a notice for that day's Federal Register.
